--- lemma_collected  (core/src/gcbridge.rs)
pub proof fn lemma_collected(ap: Program2, cb: Seq<u16>, s: State2, s1: State2, live: Seq<bool>, addr2: Seq<usize>, n0: int)
    requires
        zapped(ap, s, s1),
        collected(ap, cb, s1, live, addr2, n0),
    ensures ({
        let ren = ren_of(live);
        let back = back_of(live);
        let s2 = renamed(s1, ren, back);
        let a2 = Seq::new(back.len(), |k: int| addr2[back[k]]);
        &&& collection(ap, s, s2)
        &&& heap_model_ok(s2.heap, a2, cb)
        &&& forall|k: int, j: int, w: usize| 0 <= k < s2.heap.len() && crate::view::is_word(s1.heap[back[k]], j) ==>
                (#[trigger] word_val(s2.heap[k], cb, a2, j, w) <==> word_val(s1.heap[back[k]], cb, addr2, j, w))
        &&& enc_seq(a2, s2.stack) == enc_seq(addr2, s1.stack)
        &&& enc_seq(a2, s2.globals) == enc_seq(addr2, s1.globals)
        &&& forall|i: int| 0 <= i < n0 ==> #[trigger] ren[i] == i
    }),

--- theorem_process  (core/src/process.rs)
pub proof fn theorem_process(p: &Program, heap0: Seq<HeapObj>, globals0: Seq<Value>,
    ms: Seq<Machine>, es: Seq<Machine>, rs: Seq<(usize, i64)>, i: int)
    requires
        scheduled(p, ms, es, rs),
        loaded(p, &ms[0], heap0, globals0),
        !p.ap@.unchecked,
        0 <= i < ms.len(),
    ensures
        ms[i].inv(p),
        reaches(p.ap@, initial_state(p.ap@, heap0, globals0), ms[i].g@),
        !(sp::step(p.ap@, ms[i].g@) is Stuck),
        forall|s1: State2, module: u8, index: u16, o: Outcome2|
            sp::step(p.ap@, ms[i].g@) == Outcome2::Primitive(s1, module, index)
                && #[trigger] completion(p.ap@, s1, module, index, o)
                ==> !(o is Stuck),
        forall|o: Outcome2| #[trigger] outcome(p.ap@, ms[i].g@, o) ==> !(o is Stuck) && !(o is Raise),
        machine_objects_ok(p.ap@, ms[i].g@),

--- lemma_array_at_spec  (spec/src/v2/sound_prim_spec.rs)
pub proof fn lemma_array_at_spec(p: Program2, c: Cert, h: Seq<HeapObj>, arr: Value, i: i64, id: int, e: Seq<Value>)
    requires
        crate::v2::exec::wf_program2(p), heap_ok(p, c, h), consts_ok(p, h), h.len() < 0x4000_0000,
        array_of(h, arr) == Some((id, e)),
    ensures ({
        let args = seq![arr, Value::Smi(i)];
        &&& 0 <= i < e.len() ==>
                prim_spec(p, 0, PRIM_ARRAY_AT as u16, args, h, h, PrimRet::Success(e[i as int]))
        &&& !(0 <= i < e.len()) && -0x8000_0000 <= i < 0x8000_0000 ==>
                prim_spec(p, 0, PRIM_ARRAY_AT as u16, args, h, h, PrimRet::Failure(p.roots[ROOT_OUT_OF_BOUNDS]))
    }),

--- lemma_tail_moved  (spec/src/v2/sound_tail.rs)
pub proof fn lemma_tail_moved(s: State2, a: int, user: int, cap: Seq<Value>)
    requires 0 <= a <= s.stack.len(), 0 <= base(s), base(s) + 1 + user <= s.stack.len(), 0 <= user,
    ensures
        s.stack.subrange(s.stack.len() - a, s.stack.len() as int)
            == moved_args(s, s.stack.len() - a, a, Seq::empty()),
        s.stack.subrange(base(s) + 1, base(s) + 1 + user) + cap == moved_args(s, base(s) + 1, user, cap),
        Seq::<Value>::empty() == moved_args(s, s.stack.len() as int, 0, Seq::empty()),

--- lemma_replace_frame_slots  (spec/src/v2/sound_tail.rs)
pub proof fn lemma_replace_frame_slots(p: Program2, s: State2, t: int, from: int, n: int, cap: Seq<Value>)
    requires
        !has_handler(s),
        0 <= base(s) <= s.stack.len(), 0 <= from, 0 <= n, from + n <= s.stack.len(),
    ensures ({
        let s2 = tail_state(p, s, t, moved_args(s, from, n, cap));
        &&& replace_frame(p, s, t, moved_args(s, from, n, cap)) == Outcome2::Next(s2)
        &&& s2.stack.len() == base(s) + n + cap.len()
        &&& forall|i: int| 0 <= i < base(s) ==> #[trigger] s2.stack[i] == s.stack[i]
        &&& forall|i: int| 0 <= i < n ==> #[trigger] s2.stack[base(s) + i] == s.stack[from + i]
        &&& forall|j: int| 0 <= j < cap.len() ==> #[trigger] s2.stack[base(s) + n + j] == cap[j]
    }),

--- theorem_soundness_split  (spec/src/v2/split.rs)
pub proof fn theorem_soundness_split(p: Program2, g: GCert, ms: Seq<Maps>, trusted: bool,
    heap0: Seq<HeapObj>, globals0: Seq<Value>, s: State2)
    requires
        split_ok(p, g, ms, trusted),
        loaded_ok(p, with_maps(g, ms), heap0, globals0),
        reachable(p, heap0, globals0, s),
        !p.unchecked,
    ensures
        !(step(p, s) is Stuck),
        forall|s1: State2, module: u8, index: u16, o: Outcome2|
            step(p, s) == Outcome2::Primitive(s1, module, index) && #[trigger] completion(p, s1, module, index, o)
                ==> !(o is Stuck),
        machine_objects_ok(p, s),

--- Program::kind_byte_of  (core/src/exec.rs)
pub fn kind_byte_of(&self, i: usize) -> (r: u8)
    requires i < self.methods@.len(), self.mt_ok(),
    ensures r & KIND_MASK == self.minfo(i as int).kind,

--- Machine::set_field_val  (core/src/fields.rs)
pub fn set_field_val(&mut self, p: &Program, wo: usize, Ghost(o): Ghost<Value>, f: usize, w: usize, Ghost(v): Ghost<Value>)
    requires
        old(self).refines(p),
        wo == enc(old(self).addr(), o),
        o is Obj,
        (o->Obj_0 as int) < old(self).g@.heap.len(),
        old(self).g@.heap[o->Obj_0 as int].body is Instance,
        f < old(self).g@.heap[o->Obj_0 as int].body->Instance_0.len(),
        !old(self).g@.heap[o->Obj_0 as int].ro,
        w == enc(old(self).addr(), v),
        encodable(old(self).addr(), v),
    ensures
        final(self).refines(p),
        final(self).g@ == sp::set_field2(old(self).g@, o, f as int, v),
        final(self).top == old(self).top,
        final(self).bci == old(self).bci,
        final(self).same_stack(old(self)),

--- Cursor::clone  (core/src/view.rs)
fn clone(&self) -> (r: Self)
    ensures r == *self,

--- step_verified  (spec/src/exec_step.rs)
pub fn step_verified(p: &ExecProgram, s: &mut ExecState) -> (r: Option<ExecOutcome>)
    requires wf_program(p@), wf_state(old(s)@),
    ensures
        match r {
            Some(o) => matches(step(p@, old(s)@), o, final(s)@),
            None => final(s)@ == old(s)@,
        },

--- verify_shipped_progress  (spec/src/progress.rs)
pub fn verify_shipped_progress<P: Progress>(p: &VProgram, cert: &[u8], global_count: u64, prim_arity: &[Vec<u8>],
                                            trusted: bool, progress: P)
    -> (res: Result<(bool, usize), Oom>)
    ensures
        res matches Ok(r) ==> (r.0 ==> exists|c: Cert| accepts(vview(p), c, trusted) && #[trigger] c.global_count == global_count as int
            && c.prim_arity == prim_view(prim_arity@)),

--- verify_shipped  (spec/src/v2/cert.rs)
pub fn verify_shipped(p: &VProgram, cert: &[u8], global_count: u64, prim_arity: &[Vec<u8>], trusted: bool)
    -> (res: Result<(bool, usize), Oom>)
    ensures
        res matches Ok(r) ==> (r.0 ==> exists|c: Cert| accepts(vview(p), c, trusted) && #[trigger] c.global_count == global_count as int
            && c.prim_arity == prim_view(prim_arity@)),

--- step_verified  (spec/src/v2/exec.rs)
pub fn step_verified(p: &ExecProgram, s: &mut ExecState) -> (r: Option<ExecOutcome2>)

    ensures
        match r {

        r is Some ==> r->0@.len() == e.methods@.len()

--- vprogram_of  (spec/src/v2/vprog.rs)
pub fn vprogram_of<'a>(e: &'a ExecProgram, methods: MTable<'a>, h: u16) -> (r: VProgram<'a>)
    requires
        methods@.len() == e.methods@.len(),
        forall|i: int| 0 <= i < e.methods@.len() ==> #[trigger] minfo(methods@[i], h) == e.methods@[i],
    ensures vview(&r) == pview2(e),
